snippet.title: HAWX 2 Debut Trailer [US]
snippet.description:
HAWX 2 takes flight this fall with brand new features: take off and landing, mid-air refueling, UAVs, night vision raids and much more. 

Check out http://hawxgame.com/ for more exciting game information.
